name: notion-update-folder

file_upload_ids.description: Required for add_files. One or more file upload IDs returned by the file upload tools.

file_urls.description: Required for remove_files. The exact file URLs shown in the Folder's latest fetch output.

folder_id.description: The ID of the Folder to update.

title.description: Required for add_subfolder. The new Folder's title.
